# Convivial Concierge

> Convivial Concierge (Sort Inc.) is a property concierge company. It provides resident, tenant and guest concierge, on site or virtual, for multifamily, office, mixed-use, hotel, senior living, student housing, medical office and retail properties, with a focus on real estate owned by family offices. It works alongside the owner's property manager, starts with a 90-day pilot at one property, and reports monthly to the owner.

Contact: gabe@convivialconcierge.com

## Key pages

- [Concierge for family office real estate](https://convivialconcierge.com/family-offices/): why long-hold owners use concierge and how a portfolio rollout works
- [Multifamily & luxury residential](https://convivialconcierge.com/solutions/multifamily/): Convivial Concierge runs resident concierge for apartment, condo and build-to-rent communities: front-desk hospitality, package and errand handling, move-in welcomes, resident events and on-demand requests.
- [Mixed-use districts & master-planned communities](https://convivialconcierge.com/solutions/mixed-use/): Convivial Concierge gives a mixed-use property one hospitality team that serves residents, office tenants, shoppers and visitors at once.
- [Hotels, resorts & branded residences](https://convivialconcierge.com/solutions/hospitality/): Convivial Concierge staffs, extends or fully runs the concierge desk for hotels, resorts and branded residences.
- [Office & tenant experience](https://convivialconcierge.com/solutions/office/): Convivial Concierge runs lobby hospitality, visitor welcome, amenity-floor hosting, tenant events and workplace requests for office buildings.
- [Senior living](https://convivialconcierge.com/solutions/senior/): Convivial Concierge provides non-clinical lifestyle concierge for senior living and active-adult communities: errands, transportation booking, outings, events and coordination with residents' families.
- [Student housing](https://convivialconcierge.com/solutions/student/): Convivial Concierge runs move-in day operations, high-volume package handling, community events and parent communications for purpose-built student housing, so the leasing team can focus on pre-leasing for next year.
- [Life science, medical office & healthcare](https://convivialconcierge.com/solutions/life-science/): Convivial Concierge provides lobby hosting, patient and visitor wayfinding, amenity programming and tenant services for life science campuses and medical office buildings, so the people arriving find the building calm and easy to use.
- [Retail centres & lifestyle destinations](https://convivialconcierge.com/solutions/retail/): Convivial Concierge runs guest services for retail centres and lifestyle destinations: a staffed guest-services desk, hands-free shopping, events, visitor and tourism programs and retailer support, so shoppers stay longer and come back.
